dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noSpendingMessage: Add a transaction to see the breakdown.
dashboard.noInvoicesMessage: Add a card and its invoices will show up here.
dashboard.incomplete: This month is past the last generated occurrence of an open-ended recurring rule, so it shows only what has been scheduled so far. Those rules are extended a month at a time.
dashboard.acrossAccountsEom: Across {{count}} account(s) at end of month, {{amount}}
dashboard.expenseHint: Account spending this month, plus the invoices falling due in it
dashboard.balancesNote: Balances are your initial balance plus account transactions up to the end of the selected month — paying an invoice posts a debit, so one already paid has left them. The total then has any unpaid invoice due by then taken off it, which is why it will not match the per account figures below: that money is committed but not yet drawn from one account.
dashboard.billsNote: Already deducted from the balances above — ticking one changes no figure. Tap to correct an amount.

accounts.title: Bank accounts
accounts.subtitle: Where your money actually sits.
accounts.emptyMessage: Add an account before recording transactions or cards.
accounts.balanceHint: What the account holds right now. Transactions are applied on top of it.
accounts.deleteMessage: Permanently delete "{{name}}"? Any cards drawn on it, their invoices, and every transaction on the account are deleted too. This cannot be undone.

adjust.newBalanceHint: What your bank says the account holds.
adjust.notice: Changing the balance records an adjustment transaction for the difference. It will appear in your transaction list.
adjust.confirm: Set "{{name}}" to {{target}}? This records an adjustment transaction of {{delta}}.

cards.title: Credit cards
cards.subtitle: Each one bills against an account.
cards.emptyMessage: Add a card to start tracking charges and invoices.
cards.noAccountsMessage: Cards must be attached to an account, so create one before adding a card.
cards.bankAccountHint: Every card is attached to an account.
cards.dueDayHint: Rolls to the next month when on or before the closing day.
cards.deleteMessage: Permanently delete "{{name}}"? The card’s invoices and every charge on them are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
cards.usedSummary: {{used}} of {{limit}} used · closes day {{closing}} · due day {{due}}

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.subtitle: Debits, credits and card charges.
transactions.emptyMessage: No transactions match the current filters.
transactions.repeatCount: Every month, set number of times
transactions.chargeHint: The charge is added to the card's open invoice automatically.
transactions.deleteMessage: Delete "{{description}}"? If it is a card charge, the invoice total will be recalculated.

scope.intro: This transaction is part of a series. Which ones should this apply to?
scope.singleHint: The rest of the series is left alone.
scope.allHint: Every {{unit}} in the series, including past ones.
scope.stopsRule: The rule stops generating new {{units}} as well.

transactions.kindLocked: Type and account cannot be changed after creation.
transactions.installmentLocked: Installments are card purchases, so the type is fixed to a card charge.
transactions.systemLocked: Balance and invoice adjustments cannot be edited.
transactions.installmentAmountHint: The full purchase price. It is split across the installments.
transactions.ruleCreatedDetail: The transactions it generates are now in your list.
transactions.paidHint: Only a reminder. The amount is already deducted from the balance; ticking it changes no figure.

recurring.intro: Rules are created by adding a transaction that repeats. They cannot be edited — stop one and create a replacement instead.
recurring.emptyMessage: Add a transaction and set it to repeat, or split a card purchase into installments.
recurring.stopMessage: Stop generating "{{description}}"? Transactions already created are kept.

ingest.title: Imports
ingest.subtitle: Statements and exports waiting to be reviewed before anything reaches your ledger.
ingest.emptyMessage: Import a statement or bank export and its transactions are staged here for review.
ingest.uploadingReading: Reading the statement. This can take a moment — a layout no reader recognises is read by the model.
ingest.uploadDuplicateDetail: This document has been imported before and was left unchanged.
ingest.uploadUnsupportedDetail: No parser recognised this file. The original is stored, so it can be imported again once one exists.
ingest.reviewSubtitle: Confirm, correct or reject each line. Nothing is written until you confirm it.
ingest.originalFailed: Could not open the original file. Try again.
ingest.validationFailed: These lines do not add up to the total the issuer printed, so one is missing or counted twice. Do not file them until the difference is explained.
ingest.targetHint: One card or account for the whole statement.
ingest.missingCategory: {{count}} selected lines still need a category.
ingest.missingTarget: Choose the card or account these lines belong to.
ingest.nothingStagedMessage: This document has no lines waiting for review.

blocked.payment: Settles an invoice — pay it from Invoices
blocked.balanceCarry: Last month’s balance, not a new expense
blocked.creditOnCard: Money back on a card — record it manually

ingest.rollbackMessage: This deletes the {{count}} transactions the import created from your ledger. Staged lines go back to waiting for review.
ingest.deleteMessage: Removes this document and its staged lines from the import list. Nothing in your ledger changes. The original file stays stored and can be imported again.
ingest.storedOnlyFormats: {{formats}} can be uploaded, but no reader handles them yet — the file is kept until one does.
ingest.templateHint: No statement to hand? Download the CSV template, fill in one transaction per row and import it back.
ingest.allTypesDisabled: Importing is switched off for every format right now. An administrator can turn one back on under Import settings.
ingest.typeDisabledDetail: {{type}} imports are switched off right now, so nothing was stored. Use another format, or ask an administrator to turn it back on.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.subtitle: Created automatically when you post a card charge.
invoices.emptyMessage: Nothing was billed on this card in the selected month.
invoices.payMessage: Mark this invoice of {{amount}} as paid?
invoices.unpayMessage: Reopen this invoice? Its status goes back to open and the paid date is cleared.

adjust.newTotalHint: The total on the statement your card issuer sent.
adjust.notice: This records an adjustment charge on the invoice for the difference. It will appear alongside the invoice's other charges.
adjust.confirm: Set this invoice to {{target}}? This records an adjustment charge of {{delta}} on it.

invoices.noCardsMessage: Add a card and its invoices will show up here.
invoices.deleteMessage: Permanently delete this {{amount}} invoice? Every charge on it is deleted too. This cannot be undone.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: How your spending is grouped.
categories.typeHint: Income categories are for money coming in.
categories.deleteMessage: Permanently delete "{{name}}"? Transactions using it will be affected.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your account details, held by Planelyx's sign-in service.
profile.emailHint: Changing this marks the address as unverified until you confirm it.
profile.passwordMessage: Passwords are handled by the sign-in service, not by Planelyx. Changing one opens its account page in a new tab.

importSettings.title: Import settings
importSettings.subtitle: What the import service accepts, and how hard it tries to read it. Changes take effect in seconds, with no restart.
importSettings.formatsMessage: A format switched off here is refused on upload, before anything is stored.
importSettings.readingMessage: What happens when a statement layout defeats the deterministic reader.
importSettings.inert: On, but this server has no API key configured, so nothing is escalated.
importSettings.propagates: Every server picks this up within about fifteen seconds.
importSettings.unavailableMessage: The import service did not return its feature flags. Check that it is running.

pdfStatement.label: PDF statements
pdfStatement.description: Card invoices and bank statements as PDF. This is the path that may call the language model, so it is the one that costs money.

csv.label: CSV imports
csv.description: The filled-in transaction template. Deterministic and free.

ofx.label: OFX files
ofx.description: Uploaded and stored, but no reader handles OFX yet.

receiptImage.label: Receipt photos
receiptImage.description: Uploaded and stored, but no reader handles images yet.

llmEscalation.label: Language-model fallback
llmEscalation.description: When the deterministic reader cannot reconcile a PDF, send it to Claude. Turning this off keeps PDF imports working, but an unreadable layout stays unreadable — and stops costing anything.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: The page you were looking for is not here.

validation.email: That doesn't look like an email address.
validation.cardAccount: Pick the account it bills to.
validation.amountPositive: Amount must be greater than zero.
validation.adjustmentDate: Pick a date for the adjustment.

errors.offlineDetail: Check that the API is running and that CORS allows this origin.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
